# EDTRDocs (Online WordPad)

> EDTRDocs is a free browser-based word processor at wordpad.info, developed by 312. It supports individual writing, DOCX import and document export, with guest editing and optional account sync.

EDTRDocs is independent of Microsoft, Google and Notion. It is not Microsoft WordPad or Microsoft Word Online. Guest documents save in the current browser; signed-in documents can sync to an account. DOCX import is content conversion, not a guarantee of identical Word layout. There is no simultaneous multiplayer editing. Product reference reviewed on 2026-10-31.

## Product reference

- [Product facts and limitations](https://wordpad.info/llms.md): Saving modes, supported formats, account behavior and editing workflow.
- [Reviewed product reference and guides in one file](https://wordpad.info/llms-full.txt): Generated from the product reference and six reviewed guides, with source URLs and dates.

## Word alternatives and DOCX help

- [Online Word alternative](https://wordpad.info/guides/online-word-alternative/index.md): Everyday writing, optional sign-in and when Word is a better fit.
- [Open DOCX online](https://wordpad.info/guides/open-docx-online/index.md): Open, edit and export a Word file, with formatting and storage limitations.
- [Google Docs alternative](https://wordpad.info/guides/google-docs-alternative/index.md): Individual writing versus live shared editing.
- [Export to Word](https://wordpad.info/guides/export-to-word-docx-online/index.md): Download DOCX and choose between editable and fixed-layout formats.
- [WordPad vs Google Docs](https://wordpad.info/guides/wordpad-vs-google-docs/index.md): Distinguishes classic WordPad, EDTRDocs and Google Docs.
- [WordPad vs Microsoft Word](https://wordpad.info/guides/wordpad-vs-microsoft-word/index.md): Browser and desktop workflows, including free Word web apps.
